title: Bystander effect
scene: A middle-school student crouches to gather three dropped notebooks in a hallway. Six nearby classmates stand in a loose semicircle with hands at their sides, looking sideways at each other rather than stepping forward, each waiting for someone else. Ordinary mild hesitation, no cruel laughing or pointing. The crouching student is unhurt. Simple coherent body poses and hairstyles, limited objects and ample space between figures.
alt: A student gathers dropped notebooks while six nearby classmates glance at one another and wait instead of stepping forward to help.
